indication: external topical use for skin infections
recommended_usage: apply with gauze or cotton swab; cover with a bandage after application; wash hands after use
dosage_frequency: up to three times a day
mechanism_of_action: inhibits protein synthesis in the bacterial cell due to the oppression of isoleucine transport RNA (ribonucleic acid) - synthetase; has a bacteriostatic effect, with an increase in dose rendering a bactericidal effect
side_effects: skin itching or burning, eczema, erythema, allergic reactions, nausea, pain in the stomach, headache
unsuitable_population: children under two months; children under one year; people with severe kidney dysfunction; individuals with individual intolerance to active or additional elements of the drug; elderly people
